title: Provides clear keyboard focus for links
goal: Use :focus-visible to mark keyboard focus that needs to be visible.
summary: guide link is underlined. Add clear borders for people using the tab key, and set hover states following the same rules.
tasks: makes .guide:focus-visible display a 3px solid outline, color #125a46, and an outline offset of 3px.
retains the normal state and allows :hover to be added to the same group of selectors.

example.note: The same set of selectors can take care of both pointer hover and keyboard focus where visible cues are needed.

hint: uses outline and outline-offset. The outline is drawn outside the box, without changing the layout.
